about.p1: My work begins outside, or in front of an object lit by the window. I paint from life because nothing else gives the same charge of light, the same colour relationships, the same accidents to chase.
about.p2: I work mostly in oils on linen or fine canvas, in series rather than one-offs. Landscapes done en plein air, still lifes built up over a few days under steady studio light, interiors that come back to the same room at different hours.
about.p3: Each finished piece is signed and varnished before it leaves the studio. I ship worldwide, carefully crated and insured.
